notes.title: Opening of the Hall of Fame Update
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

The world of Singoru never stands still! On the horizon are new challenges, fresh opportunities, and even more reasons to prove yourself. And the greatest of these will be the opening of the Hall of Fame — a place where only the best of the best will remain. It is time to see what has changed in Singoru — we are sure that each of you will find something for yourself!
[hr][/hr]New Building: Hall of Fame
A historic event has taken place in our town!
The Hall of Fame has been solemnly opened — a place where the names of the greatest Braves are immortalized. Now you can prove to everyone that your name shines brighter than all among the legends!

The Hall of Fame takes into account much more than just profile level. The ranking system reflects everything that makes a player a true legend: player progress, victories over bosses, portal discoveries, and acquired equipment. To have your name appear in the Hall of Fame, it is enough to log in after the update — because only the achievements of active players are counted.

As we mentioned earlier in our diaries, over time the Hall of Fame will develop, gain new features, and become more and more interesting. Ahead await seasons and leagues, new stages, and of course, rewards. For being in the lead is already an achievement, and receiving a worthy reward for it is doubly pleasant.
[hr][/hr]Hall of Fame Rankings
Masters of Progress — Profile Level
The higher your current profile level, the higher your position in the overall list. The metric is simple and clear: as the profile level grows, the place in the Hall of Fame also rises.

Titan Hunters — Boss Kills
Glory points are awarded for victories over bosses and scale based on:

the difficulty of the location (the harder the location, the more points);

the order of the boss in the location (defeating the final boss gives more points than the first).

Lords of Aether — Portal Discoveries
Ranking for opening aether portals:

points are awarded for opening portals;

time-limited portals, opened with Prisms of Eternity, bring more ranking points.

Forges of Fate — Equipment Acquisition
Points are awarded for obtaining equipment items from various sources:

the higher the rarity and star rating of the item, the more points you receive;

the method of obtaining equipment also affects the number of points.

Clans
A separate section has already been reserved and will appear in future updates.

⚠️ Important: Titan Hunter and Lord of Aether rankings will not take into account past merits in the world of Singoru.

For all Braves the conditions will be equal: no one will gain an advantage from old merits, and the final place in the ranking will depend only on your actions after the opening of the Hall of Fame.
Now everything is in your hands — prove your mastery and earn the right to be called the best Titan Hunter or try on the crown of the Lord of Aether!
[hr][/hr]Adjustments to Unholy Barrier and Throwing Disk Evolutions
An error was discovered in which modifiers from passive abilities were not applied to the evolutions “You Shall Not Pass!” and “Queen’s Song” if the player learned these passive abilities after obtaining the evolutions themselves.

Now the system works correctly:

If the evolution was obtained earlier and the passive ability that affects this evolution was learned later, the modifiers will still be applied. The evolutions “You Shall Not Pass!” and “Queen’s Song” will receive bonuses to damage, area of effect, projectile speed, and so on.
[hr][/hr]Simplification of Early Stages of the Game
Health and Attack values of monsters have been reduced in several Normal mode locations:

Forest (from Easy to Hell difficulties),

Laboratory (from Easy to Hell difficulties),

Graveyard (from Easy to Hard difficulties),

Mycelium (Easy difficulty).

The frequency of receiving touch damage from monsters has been reduced by 2 times.

These changes are aimed at making the early stage of the game more comfortable for new players and speeding up progress in the first locations. Now the first steps in Singoru will become easier, and mastering the basic mechanics more comfortable.
[hr][/hr]Hero Rebalance
Clara:

Added a new specialization that allows, upon a successful dodge, to increase the hero’s movement speed by 30% for 1 second.
[hr][/hr]Mysterious Code
In honor of the release of the update, we are giving you a mysterious code: HALLOFFAME

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ac8bd3548349f6206a91d611421d16d3c8964c7f.png"]
[hr][/hr]
That is all for now, Brave Ones. We hope that you will appreciate the new features! Stay with us, share your impressions of the game — we are always happy to hear feedback and make the game even better!

Success to you on your path to glory — and may the Hall of Fame preserve the memory of your victories!

Brave ones!



We’re back again to tell you about all the latest updates in The Braves! So, put on your armor, grab your best weapon — and off to new adventures! It’s time to reveal what’s in store for you.


Updated Base Screen


The main base screen has been revamped and now looks a bit different. In the updated base, you’ll notice some new details, including mysterious ruins. These ruins will become the foundation of a future building — the Hall of Fame. At that very place the legends and achievements of the greatest heroes will be kept, and the building itself will be available for construction in one of the upcoming updates.
But that’s not all. While you’re exploring the updated base screen, brave heroes have already set out to scout the lands surrounding the city. Their mission is to find the perfect spot for building a brand-new mine. Previously, the base had an old mine building, but it turned out to be just an empty shell with no valuable resources. But soon, however, you’ll uncover a true discovery — the Mine will appear right on the location map, and who knows what resources and secrets it might reveal?
And remember: this is just the start! The updated base is only the first step. Future updates will bring even more new buildings and features, turning our town into a true fortress and a center of power.


New Event: Back to School


The fate of the school hangs by a thread! Night monsters have stolen the Certificates of Distinction, and only true heroes can restore justice. Hunt them down, reclaim what was lost, and save the students from retaking their exams!

notes.title: The "Era of Stars" update
notes.content:
Brave ones!

We are pleased to present to you the new major update for The Braves! We have a lot of news, big and small, so let’s not waste any time and dive straight into what awaits you!


Star Coins Drop
 Brave ones, the moment has come to test your valor!

Starting today, Star Coins have become the official reward for defeating bosses in Hardcore mode! But that’s just the beginning — soon this rare currency will become part of another unique mode. Stay tuned for updates!  Show what you're capable of — challenge the strongest opponents, face the harshest trials, and earn this truly rare currency, which will find wide use across the Singoru realms!

Let the stars witness your feats!


New Armor: Star Fortress Set
Since the Ether began calling heroes, the world has changed. Not suddenly — more like someone started a long-forgotten mechanism. The gears of fate, resting for centuries, have begun to turn again.  Strange creatures appeared, unstable portals opened, mysterious artifacts and enigmatic coins were discovered. They were called Star Coins — for their shimmering light and the feeling that each one contains a fragment of something distant and powerful.  The material of these coins turned out to be unusual. It was melted down, studied, and combined with other metals. Thus, the Star Fortress Set was born — a full set of armor created for those who face death without flinching.  What advantages does the Star Fortress Set offer, you ask? Let’s break it down:


Star Fortress Armor  
+6% health at uncommon rarity  

+16% health at rare rarity  

Reduces incoming damage by +10% at epic rarity  

+32% chance for experience drop from enemies at legendary rarity  

+0.28% armor for each percentage of missing health at mythical rarity


Star Fortress Helmet
  +6% health at uncommon rarity  

+16% health at rare rarity  

-9.9% cooldown time for abilities at epic rarity  

+7 seconds to invulnerability duration after resurrection at legendary rarity  

+20% experience gained at mythical rarity


Star Fortress Boots  
+6% health at uncommon rarity  

+16% health at rare rarity  

+11% projectile speed at epic rarity  

+7.7% movement speed at legendary rarity  

+3% health per passive skill at mythical rarity

+5.5% skill range at epic rarity  

+4% damage per evolution of active skill at legendary rarity  

30% chance of double damage for all evolutions at mythical rarity


Star Fortress Ring  
+6% attack at uncommon rarity  

+15% attack at rare rarity  

Additional skill restrictions in the match: 4 at epic rarity  

10% chance to restore 10% health upon taking damage at legendary rarity 

 +1 passive skill slot at mythical rarity


Full Set Bonus  
+2 Resurrections

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/5c03222ae7bdbd931d1115b68c7c0bedd030c9ce.png"]

Attention! This set is only available in the "Equipment" tab in the Market building and can be purchased with Star Coins.


More Control in Battle
Braves, meet one of the most useful combat interface improvements!  No more guessing and missed rotations — each active unique ability is now accompanied by a clear timer showing exactly how many seconds are left before the next use.

Even if you're just starting your journey in The Braves, the updated interface will help you get up to speed with battle mechanics faster. And if you're a veteran — your tactical play will become even more precise and confident.  Forward, Braves! Your abilities are now fully under control!


Rebalancing Frost Shards
We closely monitor how abilities perform in battle and listen to your feedback. Thanks to this, one of the old abilities has been reworked, retaining its core concept but gaining new, more efficient mechanics. We are talking about the Frost Shards and their evolution — Explosive Shards.

Previously, the shards always fired straight behind the character in a straight line. Now, they home in on the nearest enemies behind you, prioritizing those closest to the character. If there are several targets behind you, the Frost Shards will be evenly distributed among them when the ability is activated.

These changes also apply to Explosive Shards.


Notifications
You asked — we added it!  Now, all important updates are marked with notifications — those little red dots that appear on buttons, tabs, and icons when:

You receive a new piece of equipment or hero

You have enough shards to upgrade a hero's rarity

New slots open in the market or bank

New features or important events appear  

With them, it’s easier: you don’t need to search for anything — the game will guide you on where to look.  Navigation has become faster, and gameplay even more convenient!


New Academy Branch: Summoning
The Academy continues to develop, and now there is a new branch of study — specifically for summoner heroes!  The Summoning branch opens up unique abilities that strengthen summoned minions in battle.

Several heroes have reconsidered their paths and switched their specialization. Now their primary focus will be Summoning, rather than Attack, Defense, or Support, as it was before.

We present to you a list of these heroes:

Terra

Sylpha

Calizk

Jabir 

These heroes will gain access to the unique abilities of the Summoning branch and become stronger as summoners on the battlefield through their minions.

What about the resources already invested in training these heroes, you ask? The answer is simple: we will reset the upgraded skills in the Academy and return all runes and gold spent in full. This way, you can redistribute them as you see fit!

To train heroes in the Summoning branch, you will need new Summoning Runes and gold coins.  Summoning Runes can be obtained just like other runes:

In the market, as a regular resource

At points of interest during matches

By defeating bosses

By opening event chests

Or you can buy sets in the bank — quick and convenient!


Hero Rebalance
Jabir:  With the arrival of Roxy in the world of Singoru, Jabir's times have become difficult. He quickly realized that he was outmatched by the innate talent of the young demoness in controlling living flame. But he was not ready to give up.  In search of new weapons, he turned to ancient legends of a powerful artifact that grants control over fire. That’s when he found the magical lamp — the Wishbringer. And now, he has a chance to prove that skill earned through hard work surpasses any innate abilities.

You can already find the new skins in the Tavern and acquire them with Transformation Masks, Gemstones, Star Coins, or in new Bank offers!


Hot New Arrivals at the Goblin Bank!
Step into the “Best” section — rare goods are waiting for you at irresistibly good prices. Don’t miss your chance to stock up and snatch up the best deals and offer chains that are sure to win you over!

 
 New Portal Openings
Braves, do you hear the crackling of breaking ice and the roar of burning flames? The elements are clashing, and at their intersection, guided by the Ether, new heroes arrive in the world! Meet the Portal of the Elemental Crossroads and the Portal of Elemental Confrontation!

In the Portal of the Elemental Crossroads, three new unique heroes await you. What can they do? What will they surprise you with? Let’s take a closer look:

Legendary Attack Hero  Singoru has given her everything she dreamed of: endless adrenaline, stunning looks, and superpowers. Summon demons to explode in front of enemies? No problem! notes.title: Wind of Change Update!
notes.content:
Brave ones!

We present to your attention a major new update for The Braves! We have lots of news, both big and small, so let's not waste time and quickly find out what awaits you!

New modes: Chase and Invasion

We've prepared a series of new challenges for you - location modes. Each mode will specialize in a specific type of resource. So if you need hero manga to strengthen your heroes, then welcome to the "Chase" mode. And if you need construction materials for your base or runes for training at the Academy, it's better to choose the "Invasion" mode.
These modes are available in all locations, but certain conditions in normal and hardcore modes must be met to unlock them.
All game modes are available in each location, but certain conditions in normal and hardcore modes must be completed to unlock them.

The progression system is built logically: for example, to unlock the "Invasion" mode in the "Forest" location on "Easy" difficulty, you first need to complete the "Easy" level in the "Graveyard" location in normal mode.

Important note: resistance levels may vary even within the same location.
Don't worry about planning your path - the game will clearly show which stages and at what difficulty level need to be completed to unlock new opportunities.

Let's take a closer look at each of the new modes:

"Chase" mode

Something incredible has happened in Singoru. The monsters that used to act chaotically have suddenly united around the strongest. They have chosen leaders for themselves - powerful creatures that they began to worship as deities. These leaders are not only smarter and stronger than their brethren, but also have a magical connection with ancient altars that grant them immortality.
We've tried to make each match in "Chase" mode unique. Each location has its own leader monster with special abilities and behavior tactics.

How the new mode works:

From the very beginning of the match, an immortal leader monster will be chasing you. It cannot be killed in the usual way - it will pursue you until the altars connected to it are destroyed. But be careful: the monster won't just follow you. It will use its abilities to block paths, slow you down, or even call for reinforcements.

Main objective - act quickly. Explore the location, find the altars and destroy them before the monster catches up with you. But remember: the enemy won't sit idly by! The longer you delay, the more dangerous the situation becomes. And if you don't manage to sever the monster leader's connection with the altars by the end of the match, you will lose this battle.

"Invasion" mode

The standard rules no longer apply - now every match turns into a task to eliminate the threat. Ready for a real challenge? We present the new "Invasion" mode - dynamic, intense, requiring not only strength but also a well-thought-out strategy.

How the new mode works:

At the beginning of the game, portals appear in the location and you have 5 minutes to destroy them and defeat the guardians - the Ethereal Hounds.
The higher the difficulty, the more stages: from one to three, each lasting 5 minutes.
Let's look at Easy difficulty: as soon as you appear in the location, a countdown timer starts. Portals appear on the map, and within the allotted 5 minutes of the stage you need to destroy the portals and defeat the invaders that appear from these very portals. If the portals or Ethereal Hounds are not destroyed when time runs out - it counts as a defeat.
If you manage to destroy the portals and Ethereal Hounds within the allotted time, then at the end of each stage you will face the location boss containing coveted resources and equipment.

Match duration changes

Changes have occurred in the world of Singoru! Match durations have been shortened, making them more dynamic and exciting. This innovation not only speeds up gameplay but also makes it more thrilling. Now you'll have more opportunities to test your skills in a short time and enjoy every moment on the battlefield!
Let's see how much time it will take:

 Easy difficulty level of Normal mode, Chase and Invasion modes can be completed in just 5 minutes;
 Medium - in 10 minutes;
 Hard, Impossible and Infernal - in just 15 minutes;
 Hardcore mode match duration remains unchanged at 15 minutes.

With the reduction in match duration, the number of bosses in locations has also changed:

 On Easy difficulty - 1 boss
 On Medium difficulty - 2 bosses
 On Hard, Impossible and Infernal - 3 bosses

What about rewards, you ask? Although there are fewer bosses, the amount of rewards remains the same. So you'll be able to get the same resources and equipment items in less time!

Prism fragments turn into star coins

We've carefully analyzed your feedback and would like to note the impressive efficiency of some players in collecting prism fragments. Unfortunately, the number of fragments obtained has significantly exceeded our expectations, creating a certain imbalance in the game economy.

We've also noticed that the current fragment usage system turned out to be quite limited and didn't provide sufficient variety of gameplay opportunities. We strive to offer you broader prospects and diverse options for using in-game currency.

Considering your comments that the ability to obtain resources for summoning heroes and weapons is wonderful, but gameplay shouldn't be limited to just this, we've decided to make significant changes. We're abandoning prism fragments and introducing a new currency - Star Coins.

In return, we're introducing a more flexible system where Star Coins can be used to purchase a wide range of in-game items and opportunities. This will make gameplay more varied and exciting, giving you more choices and opportunities for development.

At this stage of implementing Star Coins, you can expect:

 Hero fragments in the "Hero Fragments" section of the Market
 Transformation Masks in the "Resources" section of the Market
 Various character appearances in the Tavern
 Ether and Infinity Prisms in the Bank and Market buildings at the following rates:
 Ether Prism - 150 Star Coins
 Infinity Prism - 300 Star Coins

All prism fragments you currently have will be automatically converted into the new currency - Star Coins at a 1:1 ratio.

In the future, we plan to expand the list of available items for Star Coins to make your gameplay even more exciting and varied.

Join the new era of Singoru and enjoy the updated economy system!

Gift Marathon: Monthly

Monthly

The Monthly Gift Marathon starts with the first monthly marathon that will last 28 days, after which it will switch to a cyclical mode.
The Monthly Gift Marathon will offer you 28 days of continuous reward collection. No tasks - just log into the game and claim your daily bonuses.
After completing the main stage, the gift marathon will switch to cyclical mode, where the rewards will change, but you'll be able to receive them using the familiar scheme. This will allow you to plan your time and always know when to expect new gifts.
No need to complete complex conditions or special requirements - just play and receive your bonuses. If you want more, we've prepared a premium part of the marathon with additional bonuses.

Sight customization

Now you can flexibly customize your sight in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/a1431e8bb4059b648fdd4b65a748aa1c9c666390.gif

Cursor aiming - advanced mode with full control over shots. Now you can precisely direct weapons through the cursor, which is especially important for experienced players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8ecba610a3435cf7c851684638ff456ac541aed0.gif

We've added a convenient switch so you can choose the most comfortable aiming method. On PC, you have two options:

 Through game settings.

In the mobile version, which will be released soon, you'll only be able to change the aiming mode through the settings menu.

The choice is yours! Customize the aiming type to suit your playstyle. Remember: in cursor aiming mode, shot accuracy depends entirely on your skills and experience.

This innovation will allow you to easily see how many summon attempts remain until guaranteed receipt of a legendary hero or equipment item, making the summoning process more convenient and transparent!

notes.title: Developer Diary #26
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We're pleased to present a new installment of the "Developer Diary"!

For everyone eager to learn about the upcoming changes and innovations in the world of Singoru, we're ready to lift the veil of mystery. In this new issue, we'll discuss marketplace changes, a new marathon event, and new functionality!

Major Economic Changes

We're delighted to present important changes that will make your gaming adventure even more exciting and rewarding. We always strive to ensure every game element is enjoyable and truly valuable to you. That's why we've reworked the prism shard system and prepared something special!

Prism Shards Convert to Star Coins!

After carefully analyzing your feedback, we've noted the impressive efficiency some players demonstrated in collecting prism shards. Unfortunately, the number of shards obtained significantly exceeded our expectations, creating some imbalance in the game economy.

We also noticed the current shard system was quite limited and didn't provide sufficient gameplay diversity. We want to offer you broader prospects and more varied uses for in-game currency.

Considering your comments that while obtaining resources for hero and weapon summoning is great, gameplay shouldn't be limited to just that, we've decided to implement major changes. We're phasing out prism shards and introducing a new currency - Star Coins.

In their place, we're introducing a more flexible system where Star Coins can be used to purchase a wide range of in-game items and opportunities. This will make gameplay more diverse and engaging, giving you more choices and progression options.

Coming soon:

 Exclusive cosmetic items!
 Valuable game resources - helping you progress faster!
 And much more - stay tuned for announcements!

All your existing prism shards will be automatically converted to the new currency - Star Coins at a 1:1 ratio.

Temporary Changes to Star Coin Acquisition

To ensure a smooth transition to the new system, we need to adjust market balance and drop rates for the new currency. Therefore, we're temporarily discontinuing prism shard rewards from hardcore mode.

But we've made sure you won't lose your favorite resource! Now you can earn Star Coins in the daily marathon - just log in every day to claim generous rewards!

Gift Marathon

The "Gift Marathon" begins with the first monthly marathon lasting 28 days, after which it will transition to a cyclical format.

The marathon offers 28 days of continuous rewards. No quests needed - just log in daily to claim your bonuses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8ccdb2fe5a293256d3f5633b3e2bb3e8ce1753ce.png

After the initial phase, the marathon will cycle with changed rewards, while maintaining the same claiming system. This lets you plan your time and always know when to expect new gifts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/16f712f40007ff18daaf1ed2a85ae6ddd4c00012.png

Our well-designed reward system makes the marathon accessible to everyone. No complex conditions or special requirements - just play and claim your bonuses. For those wanting more, we've prepared a premium marathon track with additional rewards.

Evolution Skill Changes

We've carefully reviewed all your feedback and suggestions. Thanks to your active participation and valuable comments, we've revamped several skills - and this is just the beginning!

Boulder → Earth Barrage
(Stone Shrapnel Evolution)

Boulder has transformed into mighty Earth Barrage. This isn't just an upgrade - instead of a single hit, you now get a devastating volley of stone projectiles. Each shot becomes a hail of fragments, obliterating everything in its path.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/404347557f9132d479814268f76199908d9ad78a.gif

Supernova → Explosive Shards
(Ice Shards Evolution)

Supernova has become destructive Explosive Shards. This new ability takes the best from frost shards, but now each icy projectile explodes, engulfing enemies in cold and slowing their movements. Enemies don't just take damage - they're trapped in frost!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8577ab50f7ce05113504422f571ac084b87dea2b.gif

Queen's Song
(Chakram Evolution)

Queen's Song has been reborn. The spell now hits enemies with multiple projectiles, creating a mesmerizing spectacle. The reworked visual effect turns the ability into a true performance, with each projectile dancing through the air before finding its target.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8018a2025cf361ec07e5fc896711799b054b7404.gif

New Aiming Mode

The game now features flexible aiming settings.

Auto-Aim - The classic mode where the game automatically helps target enemies. Perfect for dynamic combat and beginners.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/a1431e8bb4059b648fdd4b65a748aa1c9c666390.gif

Cursor Aiming - An advanced mode offering full control over shots. You can now precisely aim using the cursor, especially valuable for experienced players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8ecba610a3435cf7c851684638ff456ac541aed0.gif

We've added a convenient toggle so you can choose your preferred aiming style. On PC, you have two options:

 During gameplay via a dedicated button (F).
 Through game settings.

In the upcoming mobile version, aiming mode can only be changed through settings.
This new feature currently affects only certain skills:

 Stone Shrapnel
 Earth Barrage
 Crushing Blow
 Compass of Pain
 Thunder Arrows
 Arrow Storm
 Steel Fan

The choice is yours! Customize aiming to match your playstyle. Remember: in cursor mode, accuracy depends entirely on your skill and experience.

Experiment with both modes to find what works best for you. You can change settings anytime during gameplay, so nothing stops you from enjoying convenient auto-aim until truly challenging moments when you might want to take full control!

notes.title: Developer Diary #25
notes.content:
Brave ones!

We are excited to present a new edition of the "Developer Diary"!

For all those eager to learn about the changes and innovations awaiting the world of Singor in the near future, we are ready to lift the veil of mystery. In this edition, we will discuss the focus weapons for each of the new heroes.

Scythe - Lord of the Dead

When the world was young, and the concepts of life and death had not yet taken clear boundaries, the ancient gods of Darkness forged a scythe from shards of fading stars and bones of primordial beings. The artifact, named "Lord of the Dead," became an embodiment of primal balance - for every second life granted, it demanded immediate payment.

Kalizk acquired this scythe in the Temple of Eternal Silence, where it had rested for centuries on an altar made of skulls. As his fingers closed around the handle covered in ancient inscriptions, a whisper echoed in the silence: "At last - a worthy Accountant...". From that day on, a strange connection was established between them: the scythe did not merely serve him - it taught him, showing the true cost of disrupting the natural order.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/b58c8a21668b20ce7091008fca956466f67ff1ad.png

"Do you think this is just a weapon?" - laughs the scythe in rare moments when it allows Kalizk to hear its voice. "I am the scales on which death itself is weighed. And you are merely the pointer indicating measure."

Fan - Song of the Heavens

In the mountains where clouds are born, an ancient fan woven from golden sunlight and cloud silk lay resting. When Sylph unfolded it, the golden spokes sang — and their song awakened slumbering elementals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/820b715e4fae5f66637ce7a31821d65ba1a475db.png

This artifact became her destiny. In battles, a single wave of the fan summoned whirlwind guardians, while the ringing of golden spokes called upon ancient storm spirits for aid. But with power came a price: after each battle, Sylph had to sing new songs to the wind — otherwise, patterns on the pristine silk began to fade, along with them disappeared trust from elementals.

“We dance to the music of your heart,” — whisper the winds as they swirl around golden spokes. And as long as this song plays, Song of the Heavens will guard the valleys of Singor.

Tablets - Tablets of Summoning

In sacred quarries where wind has polished rocks for centuries, earth priests found three gray tablets made from an unknown mineral. Smooth as polished river pebbles, they were covered with pulsating pink runes — a living language of Earth itself. Now these tablets are carried by Terra, mistress of stone depths, secured with a simple leather strap around her thigh. When she removes them and runs her fingers over the runes, a miracle occurs: Earth Elementals respond to her call.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/167030d2da0ead416274235767d06a8a0704fbc4.png

"They are not tools," - says Terra as she watches pink light dance on her palms. "They are a contract etched in stone when the world was still young."

notes.title: Developer Diary #24
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We're pleased to present a new installment of the "Developer Diary"!

For all those eager to learn about the changes and innovations coming to the world of Singoru in the near future, we're ready to lift the veil of mystery. In this issue, we'll talk about a new hero and share updated information about a previously announced hero. And of course, we'll show mobile version screenshots.

New Hero: Sylph

In a quiet village of the eastern Qin Empire lived a dancer named Xiao Fen.
Everything changed when a blind elder gave her a mysterious fan. At night, upon opening it, she felt a sharp pain in her chest, and her consciousness began to fade.

"You won't die," whispered the wind to her, "You'll only sleep briefly."

The dancer's soul fell into a sweet slumber in the wind's embrace, swaying on the calm waves of the Aether.

During her sleep, the wind became part of her. The fan in her hands can direct whirlwinds, slicing off treetops. Air spirits will whisper warnings, deflecting enemy arrows, and in moments of mortal danger, fully merge with her, making her faster than thought.

Perhaps the fan chose her for a reason. Perhaps somewhere between worlds awaits the answer - why she became the one who speaks with the wind as an equal. But while the fan remains in her hands and the sky above her, she'll continue her journey. After all, you can't hold the wind - you can only fly with it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2fa186d81a5324f63fc4d82332abb33105aa33a7.png

Hero skins: Fan Warrior

When Singoru's monsters began hunting the "girl in white-blue silks," the wind gifted her a new form.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/1de0e692b4c4c867b1ee05d2e198ebc8634d0179.png

In this form, every strike of her fan carries the fury of a storm. Most attacks remain ordinary, but sometimes - in moments when wind spirits fully merge with her - her attacks slice through enemies with triple force.

People whispered that what protected them now wasn't a girl, but the storm itself. And when at night a strange ringing sounded - like someone dragging a nail across a blade - monsters would glance around in fear.

For it meant a whirlwind was circling nearby... and the next strike might be their last.

"It's not armor that makes a warrior," she would say, "but the ability to become invisible to blades."

And the wind, her faithful ally, always confirmed these words.

Additional Hero Information: Kalizk

We previously introduced this hero, and since then his concept and abilities haven't changed drastically.

He can still summon loyal servants - skeletons - and resurrect in battle. In this issue, we'd like to talk about his skins, which will be added to the game with him in the upcoming update.

Kaliz'k - Servant of Balance

Kaliz'k has become more than just a sorcerer - he has become a Servant of Balance. His once simple robes have transformed into majestic armor adorned with skulls. These are not mere decorations, but hints at the power Kaliz'k wields. His eyes, once lifeless, have now disappeared entirely - replaced by eternal blue flames.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/53c69df2532eebc52bba3985a1488f36ff78d4b7.png

But the most terrifying thing - he still gives gifts. Only now they're not toys, but eternal service in his dead army. On the winter solstice eve, Kaliz'k emerges from his ice castle, and those who meet him on the road receive a "gift" - a place in his endless procession of the dead.

If you see a blue glow in the blizzard - run. Run without looking back. For the Servant of Balance loves giving gifts... especially to those who aren't expecting them.

Finally

We've already shown much of the mobile interface's appearance. Next up is the "To Battle!" tab.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/0321dece1a5e09c602e532e7d09a68be28cb55a6.png

Stay tuned, as there's much more to come! For now - share your impressions and expectations in the comments. Onward, Brave Ones!

notes.title: Developer Diary #23
notes.content:
Brave Ones!  

We are pleased to present a new installment of the "Developer Diary"!  

For all those who crave knowledge about the changes and innovations awaiting the world of Singoru in the near future, we are ready to lift the veil of mystery. In this issue, we will talk about the second (in order but not in importance) game mode and new weapons. We’ll also share new screenshots of the mobile version of the game!  

New Mode: "Invasion"  

Ready for a real challenge? We present the new "Invasion" mode—dynamic, intense, and requiring not just strength but also strategy. This isn’t just additional content; it’s a full-fledged trial.  

Availability and Difficulty  
This mode is available on all locations, but accessing it requires completing certain conditions in the normal and hardcore modes. For example, to unlock the "Easy" difficulty of the "Forest" location in the new mode, you’ll first need to clear the "Easy" difficulty in the "Graveyard" of the normal mode. But don’t worry—you won’t have to guess which stages and difficulties need to be cleared: the game provides hints to guide you!  

The difficulty levels in the new mode range from "Easy" to "Hellish." The higher the difficulty, the fiercer the enemies and the richer the rewards.  

But don’t be fooled by the name: even the "Easy" difficulty in the "Forest" location will prove to be a serious challenge—it’s comparable to "Hard" in the normal mode! So don’t expect to relax.  

New Gameplay: Race Against Time  
The standard rules no longer apply—now every match becomes a special operation to eliminate the threat:  
At the start of the game, portals appear on the location—black stone structures pulsating with an alien purple energy. Their light doesn’t illuminate—it corrodes the mind, filling it with visions of inhuman landscapes and the whispers of ancient entities. The longer you look, the clearer you feel—something beyond the thin veil of reality has already noticed you. Are those voices in your head, or is it just the blood pounding in your temples?  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/c50f3b06c563dd6791db71f0b3782f7fcae3380a.png  

You have 5 minutes to destroy the portal and defeat its guardians—Ethereal Hounds.  

The higher the difficulty, the more stages there are: from one to three, each lasting 5 minutes. Fail to complete them in time? Defeat.  
Let’s take the "Easy" difficulty as an example: as soon as you spawn, a countdown timer starts. Portals appear on the map, and within the allotted 5 minutes per stage, you must destroy the creatures emerging from them. If the portals or the hounds aren’t destroyed by the time the clock runs out—defeat is inevitable.  

In this mode, it’s crucial not only to quickly eliminate enemies and portals but also to plan your route precisely to stop the invasion of the ancient gods in time!  

Who Are the Ethereal Hounds?  
These aren’t just enemies—they are alien beings guarding the portals. They emerge in a blinding flash from the portals and attack without hesitation. Their goal is to stop you at any cost.  

The Ethereal Hound descends upon its prey in a whirlwind of lethal movements: its body seems designed for powerful lunges, and its claws slice through even the toughest armor. Beyond sheer physical strength, you must also beware of the slime it can spew if the fight transitions to long-range. And that’s far from all the tricks the Ethereal Hound has up its… sleeve.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/593a161109f0a044f963342ba153ef9d30fd0e3f.png  

The Final Showdown  
If you manage to destroy the portals, at the end of each stage, you’ll face the location’s boss. This is the culmination of the trial—a test of endurance before the well-earned reward.  

Why Play "Invasion"?  

First, to protect Singoru! The portal isn’t just an anomaly—it’s a gateway for invasion, through which the Ethereal Hounds enter the world. If left unchecked, the threat will spiral out of control. Every victory in this mode is a step toward saving the world from an extraterrestrial invasion.  

And second… the rewards!  
  
 More construction materials;  
 More runes for the Academy;  
 A trial for true heroes—only the strongest can withstand this threat.  
  

New Weapon: "Harmony of the Wind"  

The workshops of the Heavenly Stronghold still remember the story of the old master Liando, who was the first to "tame" the wind. He noticed that during autumn storms, spirits eagerly answered the call—as if nature itself sought to take form. After years of experimentation, the first fan-conduit was born, capable of summoning and commanding Air Elementals.  

At first glance, it’s just an ordinary fan, but it holds the power to command whirlwinds. No intricate carvings, no precious stones. Yet, its pattern carries a rhythm that mirrors the flow of air, and its rough wood holds the memory of forest storms.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/692e4a0fc8032e94ff8e2bbb50b13f15d9587033.png  

When a mage first unfolds it, the fan feels almost weightless in their palm—as if it might fly away at any moment. But with a single flick, the air before it comes alive, calling upon the power of the wind and the elementals bound to it.  

Finally  

Last time, we showed you what the inventory and Tavern interfaces look like on mobile devices, the "Portal" tab, and shared new Field of View (FoV) settings to make your gameplay more comfortable and immersive. Today, we’d like to draw your attention to the "Forge" interface.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/bc03e0866beffe53c11d761cbfb9445d7984ecde.png  

Stay tuned, as there’s much more to come! For now—share your impressions and expectations in the comments. Onward, Brave Ones!

notes.title: Developer Diary #22
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We’re thrilled to present a new entry in the Developer Diary!

For those eager to learn about the upcoming changes in the world of Singoru, we’re lifting the veil of mystery. This issue delves into the Monster Lords of the new "Chase" Mode, alongside new minions and weapons!

New "Chase" Mode Bosses

The Fungus Collector: Curse of the Mycelium

In the Mycelium’s shadowy depths, legends whisper of a forager who became one with the forest. Once a man who dreamed only of finding the rarest mushroom, he learned too late: the Mycelium tolerates no thieves.

His final memory? The ecstasy of discovering a scarlet toadstool flecked with gold. As his fingers closed around its fleshy cap—a click in the silence. The mushroom was part of a vast parasitic network, and in an instant, millions of spores flooded his veins.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/7cd5bb993829ace3fcc944db77e8a1e588873a9a.png
Now, he "harvests" with mushrooms bursting from his flesh. The Mycelium stitches his body with white threads—a walking incubator. His movements jerk between unnatural swaying and sudden lurches. When he pauses, bomb-mushrooms swell around him. Spores swarm the air; if prey stays distant, he hurls venomous caps.

The Mycelium left him just enough mind to comprehend his fate, but not enough to resist. In rare moments of clarity, he weeps—tears devoured by the hungry fungus. He is both warning and trap: living bait for those who dare forage this wood.

The Owl Queen: Frostcurse of the Ridge

Majestic and terrifying, the Owl Queen rules the Ridge’s snowbound peaks, where winds howl like lost souls. Legends claim she is the Creator’s forsaken child, cast into mortality for defiance. Her form blends beauty and monstrosity: feminine grace, piercing blue eyes, and claws that shred flesh like paper.

Her mountain-leopard pelts are a mockery of mortals who shiver in the cold. Beneath the furs, her body is feathered in snow-white plumes that radiate cold. Her staff is no mere symbol—it summons winter’s fury.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/54713a8943b9a95b03fa4402d26af169d90db818.png
She greets travelers with a lethal game, twirling her staff to mesmerize before striking. Her attacks are cruelly elegant: hails of icicles, freezing whirlwinds, and breath that turns intruders into statues for her frozen gallery. Rumors say her palace holds dozens of ice-encased victims, faces locked in despair.

The Owl Queen is winter incarnate—merciless and unforgiving. If you hear the melodic chime of ice in the mountains… run. That’s her laughter.

New Weapon: Necromancer’s Staff

This grim artifact is a staple of dark practitioners. A rope-wrapped wooden rod topped with a skull, its forehead branded by a blood-red pentagram. Dull crimson light flickers in its sockets—trapped souls stir within.

Such staves serve necromancers and witches as conduits to raise the dead. The more lives taken, the brighter the skull’s glow.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/0a83d50dfb16a7f946477cd347088f4159fc4408.png
A single strike on the ground cracks the earth, summoning skeletons—warriors, peasants, kings—all equal in undeath. Their bones creak; green fire burns in hollow eyes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/da9369e534bf68071765f4dad2d1b6c39c4ab283.png
But its true power awakens when soil is soaked in blood. Then, Skeleton Warriors rise—their scarred bones remember a thousand battles. Where they tread, poisoned blood pools.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2d053a11917c2677bf9ac85cdbeff70047b33791.png
Despite its crude appearance, the staff chills the bravest hearts: whispers of damned souls echo in its presence, and buried bones tremble at its approach. Spot a distant crimson glow at night? Turn back. A necromancer hunts nearby.

Final Notes
Previously, we revealed the mobile inventory UI, the Portal tab, and new FoV settings for a more immersive experience. Today, we spotlight the Tavern interface.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/137a6f09ef4ac367b305ab506cb0df227a4ce334.png
Stay tuned—more awaits! Share your thoughts in the comments. Onward, Brave Ones!

notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We are pleased to present a new issue of the "Developers' Diary"!

For everyone eager to learn about the changes and innovations awaiting the world of Singoru in the near future, we are ready to lift the veil of secrecy. In this issue, we will continue to talk about the monster lords in the new "Chase" mode, as well as new summonable creatures and weapons!

New Bosses in the "Chase" Mode

Brainiac:

A living proof that even the most harmless experiment can spiral out of control. Once, this giant flying brain was part of the body of a not-so-bright mountain giant named Gromar. Gromar was famous for his strength, but his intellect left much to be desired. Mad scientists from a secret laboratory decided to conduct experiments on him to enhance his mental abilities. However, the result exceeded all expectations: along with an incredibly increased intellect, he developed powerful psionic abilities and, with the power of thought, transformed himself into something the inhabitants of the Laboratory called Brainiac.

Now, Brainiac is a huge flying brain surrounded by an aura of psionic energy. His single eye, left from the giant, glows with a cold purple light and is the source of his power. With it, Brainiac releases paralyzing rays, creates psionic storms, causes chaotic energy bursts, and emits rays of psionic energy around himself, crushing enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/88cd0bae48363a8833bca509ee21f64fcad8dac0.png
Brainiac is a creature that clearly demonstrates that science and experiments can lead to unpredictable and dangerous consequences. His psionic power and intellect make him a formidable opponent, and his origin adds a dark irony to his image. Encountering Brainiac is a test not only of physical strength but also of the ability to resist mind manipulation.

Sandstone:

An animated dune inhabited by the soul of a powerful priest who once ruled these lands. In life, he was obsessed with power and glory, but after death, his spirit, unwilling to accept oblivion, found refuge in the desert sands.

Sandstone can sleep for centuries, satiated by the suffering of others, but once disturbed, he awakens, unleashing all his fury on the intruders. He slams into the ground, creating seismic waves, spits sand spears, releases clouds of poisonous gas or scarabs, and raises sandstorms, blinding and sweeping away everything in his path.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/a2c07154ec998b1e80ae13d5a34114c6cc7960c6.png
Sandstone is a living warning that even after death, ambitions can find a way to manifest. His destructive abilities make him a formidable opponent, and his story is a dark legend of the desert. Encountering Sandstone is a meeting with ancient evil that leaves nothing alive in its wake.

New Weapon: Mud Animator

In the world of Singoru, where magic and nature are intertwined in an inseparable unity, the "Mud Animator" was created by an ancient order of mages known as the Stone Architects. This order was famous for its mastery of geomancy—the art of controlling earth and stone. The mages of the order studied the deep forces of the world to use them for creation and protection. One of their greatest achievements was the creation of tablets that allowed them to create beings from stones, clay, and even mud!

notes.title: Dev Diary #20
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We are pleased to present a new issue of the "Developers' Diary"!

For everyone eager to learn about the changes and innovations awaiting the world of Singoru in the near future, we are ready to lift the veil of secrecy. In this issue, we will talk about a new game mechanic, a new permanent mode.

New Mechanic: Summoning Minions!

Get ready to meet one of the most large-scale and exciting mechanics that will fundamentally change the approach to strategy and tactics in the world of Singoru. Prepare to encounter a new force on the battlefield—minions! This mechanic will not only add depth to the gameplay but also open up new horizons for experimenting and combining your heroes' abilities in battle.

Coming soon to the game:

 Skeleton Warriors;
 Stone Golems;
 Air Elementals.

Air Elemental and Its Evolutions

Air Elementals will be among the first minions that the heroes of Singoru can summon to their aid:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/448f0720d59c42b55d3f0f06205a6cb850ca6b32.png
Isn't it adorable? However, don't be fooled by its appearance—this new companion will be very useful in battle! And by obtaining the necessary skills for its evolution, you can gain a truly powerful minion:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/6fa301c778923fb121ad2095e526256fd7c3915a.png

New Hero Type: Summoners

With the introduction of the summoning mechanic, we plan to create a new hero type—Summoners, which means a new skill tree will appear in the Academy! These heroes will specialize in managing summons, enhancing them, and using them tactically.

To develop summoning-related abilities in the Academy, new runes will be added, which can be obtained by participating in matches. These runes will unlock unique upgrades and abilities for your heroes.

Passive Skills and Synergy with Existing Abilities

But that's not all! Along with the new mechanic and new active abilities, passive skills will also appear in the game, which will enhance summoned creatures.
Additionally, some of the already familiar abilities will also interact with summons. For example, the Avatar of Darkness will now strengthen undead, making them even more formidable. Thus, the entire line of avatars will provide bonuses to summoned creatures of the same element.

Future Plans

We don't plan to stop at three heroes and their abilities. In future updates, you can expect:

 New abilities that will open even more possibilities for combinations with summons.
 New heroes, each offering a unique playstyle.
 New weapons specifically designed to enhance summoners and their creatures.

The summoning mechanic is not just an innovation—it's a new stage in the game's development. We strive to make the game even more diverse, strategically deep, and engaging. Prepare for your arsenal of tactics and strategies to expand significantly, and for each match to become even more dynamic and unpredictable.

New Mode: Chase

We are preparing a series of new challenges for you—location modes. Similar to the already beloved Hardcore mode, new activities will gradually be introduced into the game. Each mode will specialize in a specific type of resource. For example, if you desperately need building materials for your base, it's better to choose one mode, and if you need Heroic Manga, then another. This way, you are guaranteed to receive the reward you need here and now.
So, you can start preparing for a new challenge that will test your courage, speed, and strategic thinking. Introducing the "Chase" mode—dynamic, intense, and full of unexpected twists!

Monsters Have Found Leaders

Something incredible has happened in Singoru. Monsters, which previously acted chaotically, have suddenly united around the strongest. They have chosen leaders—powerful beings whom they now worship as deities. These leaders are not only smarter and stronger than their brethren but also possess a magical connection to ancient totems that grant them immortality.

Now, these monster leaders lead their hordes on hunts, and their target is you. But all is not lost! Even immortality has its weaknesses, and your task is to find and destroy the totems linked to the leader. Only then can you stop the chase and survive.

How Does the "Chase" Mode Work?

From the very beginning of the match, an immortal monster leader will chase you. It cannot be killed in the usual way—it will pursue you until the totems linked to it are destroyed. But be careful: the monster won't just follow you. It will use its abilities to block paths, slow you down, or even call for reinforcements.

The main task is to act quickly. Explore the location, find the totems, and destroy them before the monster catches up to you. But remember: the enemy won't sit idly by! The longer you delay, the more dangerous the situation becomes.

Unique Enemies for Each Location

We have tried to make each match in the "Chase" mode unique. Each location will have its own monster leader with special abilities and tactics.

Today, we want to show the enemy from the "Graveyard" location:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/96c148543443a86c07b94c7ed14f0286a6605548.png

In future diaries, other enemies will be gradually revealed, each representing a unique threat.

Finally

In the previous issue, we lifted the veil on upcoming changes related to the release of the mobile version of the game. We mentioned an updated interface, cross-platform progression, and many other improvements that will make the game even more convenient and accessible. Today, we would like to show another important step in this direction—the new FoV (Field of View)!

We have tried to make the FoV as comfortable as possible for both mobile devices and PCs/consoles! Moreover, we plan to make it customizable, so each player can adjust it to their preferences and playstyle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/67ee2650e3fad8c017a90e2ce9f64d710e20e748.gif

Stay tuned for more news, as there is still a lot of exciting stuff ahead! In the meantime—share your impressions and expectations in the comments. Forward, Brave Ones!

notes.title: Dev's Diary #19
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We are pleased to present you with a new issue of the "Developers' Diary"!

For everyone who is eager to learn about the changes and innovations awaiting the world of Singoru, we are ready to lift the veil of secrecy.

First, we would like to briefly talk about everything that will soon await the game and you:

 New abilities: summoning creatures;
 New Heroes;
 Changes to match duration;
 Two new modes;
 Updates to Town Hall quests;
 New locations;
 Release on new platforms and crossplay functionality;
 Hero rebalancing;
 Ability rebalancing;
 New skins;
 In-game chat.

Of course, we can't cover everything in one diary, so we recommend that you don't miss our future issues to learn more about what awaits you next!

In this issue, we will focus on one of the new heroes, changes to match duration, and the release on new platforms!

Well, let's not waste any more time!

New Hero: Terra

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/1bf0ba3d8b20bf737966e503d9947556b6ff6387.png

Terra is a mysterious and talented magical sculptor whose hands can turn ordinary stone into living works of art. Her name, meaning "earth," perfectly reflects her connection to natural materials and earth magic. Terra has the ability not only to create monumental sculptures but also to breathe life into them, imbuing them with magical power. Her main and most powerful ally is the Royal Golem, a massive creature of stone and magic that she can summon in moments of greatest danger. This golem is not only her protector but also the embodiment of her creative genius, a symbol of her mastery over the earth element.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8fd690e6455686f9e2bea69359d76a3b86c5c87e.png

Terra possesses unique abilities that make her even more dangerous and resilient in battle. With a certain chance, when picking up items or gaining experience, she can heal herself, making her durable. Additionally, her earth-element attacks (including golem strikes) can weaken enemies, temporarily reducing their damage. This makes her not only a master of earth magic but also a tactician capable of controlling the flow of battle.

In addition, we would like to show you her appearance, which will be released alongside the hero: Terra - the Cook. Having reached the pinnacle of mastery in sculpture, Terra decided to challenge herself in a new art—culinary. After all, cooking, like sculpting, requires inspiration, patience, and a fine sense of harmony. While her attempts to create a Gingerbread Golem have not yet been successful, she believes that one day her hands will be able to bring this sweet creation to life. For her, nothing is impossible when it comes to art—be it stone or dough.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2a2a60750dc7b6849942fe18c02247c9c489a146.png

Changes to Match Duration

In anticipation of upcoming updates and the release on new platforms, which we will talk about a bit later, we have decided to reduce the time you spend in matches. But don't worry—this won't affect the size of your rewards!

So, what exactly will change? These changes will affect all maps and difficulty levels in the normal mode:

 Easy difficulty can now be completed in just 5 minutes;
 Medium difficulty in 10 minutes;
 Hard, Impossible, and Hellish difficulties in 15 minutes!

We are confident that these changes will make the gameplay even more dynamic and exciting.

Cross-Platform

In the near future, we plan to release the game on mobile devices (Android/iOS), as well as on the following consoles:

 Nintendo Switch
 PlayStation 5
 PlayStation 4
 Xbox One S
 Xbox One X
 Xbox One

Imagine: you're at a friend's place, and they only have a console. "No problem!" you say, logging into the game. No more "oh, my progress is on another device." You're like a superhero, always ready for battle, whether it's on PC, phone, or console.

And if you suddenly decide to play on the subway (why not?), the mobile version won't let you down either. Progress will be synchronized on your 101XP account, so you can level up even if your PC is sitting sadly at home.

Finally, we would like to show you one of the screenshots of the future mobile interface. Please note that this interface is not the final version and may be subject to change.

Updated Ammunition:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/4e400597e35b537ac80238a8d4fd090738bb1812.jpg
Details of other changes will be revealed in future diaries!

This concludes our issue. Don't forget to share your impressions and thoughts in the comments—it's very important to us!

notes.title: Dev Diary #18
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We’re excited to present to you a new edition of the "Developer’s Diary"!

For those of you eager to learn about the changes and innovations coming to the world of Singoru, we’re ready to lift the veil of mystery. In this issue, we’ll talk about a new hero and the updates awaiting you!

So, let’s not waste any time!

New Hero: Tempesta

At the edge of the world, where the sky meets the earth and storms never cease, resides Tempesta—the goddess of wind and lightning. Her home is a boundless palace among the clouds, from where she watches over the mortal realm, commanding the elements. In her eyes, a hurricane rages, and her voice resonates like thunder.

In battle, the wind cloaks Tempesta like a veil, granting her an incredible ability to evade attacks, increasing her dodge rate every five levels. If she successfully dodges, she immediately restores a portion of her health. Even the heavens themselves stand ready to aid her, striking her enemies with lightning! But that’s just a glimpse of her abilities—after all, every woman should have her mysteries, right?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/146a4ef35bc026cfa2ec4786357d1cb71ac0bde0.png
Tempesta is a reminder that nature is powerful yet fair. She demands respect but is always willing to forgive and grant new life to those seeking harmony.

Reward Adjustments

Have you already conquered the hardcore Bran, but the daily rewards are still the same as when you first arrived in Singoru? We’ve decided to change that!

Now, as you progress through locations and unlock new difficulties, the rewards will scale accordingly!

Finally, it’s time to thrive!

Event Guarantees

Have you spent countless hours playing to get that coveted event reward, but it just won’t drop? Feeling frustrated? Well, not anymore!
Soon, all new events will feature a guaranteed drop system for event-related chests! This means that if luck abandons you, you can rely on the guarantee to ensure you get what you’ve been striving for!

That’s it for this edition of the Developer’s Diary. Don’t forget to share your impressions and thoughts in the comments—it means the world to us!

notes.title: Dev Diary #17
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We’re excited to present a new edition of the Developer’s Diary!

For everyone eager to know about the changes and innovations coming to the world of Singoru, we’re ready to lift the veil of mystery. In this issue, we’ll talk about a new hero, new functionality, and the main villain of the upcoming event!

So, let’s not waste any time!

New Hero: Visconti.

The Aether is a realm where the souls of heroes await their turn. But even there, extraordinary events can occur—things that seem impossible in the real world. For instance, the merging of opposites, which is embodied in Visconti.

Visconti is a unique mage whose potential is hard to gauge, as he is the fusion of two souls and two beginnings. His light side embodies hope and aid for those in need, while his dark side symbolizes retribution for anyone who crosses the line and brings evil to Singoru.

Visconti specializes in wielding two types of energy, allowing him to assume both light and dark forms in battle. His duality protects him, triggering explosive bursts of both energies when he’s in danger. His ability to manipulate the threads of life and fate enables him to not only attract them to his side but also change his destiny in moments of peril, even resurrecting himself after death.

This is the third winner of the Hero Creation Contest, following Aurora and Kalizka!

Authorization.

What’s the point of authorization if we’re playing through Steam? you might ask. After all, Steam already has account linking! And we’d respond with one word: cross-platform!

Yes, a new era is coming to the game, allowing you to play across different platforms. To make this possible, authorization via 101XP is required. You’ll be able to quickly authorize through the settings menu with just a couple of clicks.

While cross-platform functionality won’t be part of the next update, it’s coming to your doorstep very soon.

An Enemy Approaches!

Remember one of our recent Developer’s Diaries, where we mentioned new events? Well, we’re revealing a bit more! What awaits you there? What new mechanics will be introduced? That, we won’t tell—yet.

However, we can show you the new enemy so you can recognize them on sight!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/464657545f9dad47f27beda380f282e29fcb68a1.png
But don’t underestimate them based on appearances; they’re not as simple as they seem. They’ve got more than a few tricks up their sleeve—or, in this case, their bag!

Singoru is in for more upheavals, both good and bad. But we’re confident you’ll save this world from anything bad, just as you always have!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ca6ed5eecf6cb219a48414d868e1190854b9e35e.png
That concludes this edition of the Developer’s Diary. Don’t forget to share your thoughts and impressions in the comments—they mean a lot to us!

notes.title: The academy's grand opening!
notes.content:
Brave ones!

Meet the new after-hours update that we're sure will delight everyone! What's in store for you, you ask? Read on and find out! 

New building — The Academy
For a long time this building stood abandoned, but thanks to the efforts of the Braves, the Academy found new teachers. Now anyone can rebuild the Academy and train their heroes in it. 
Training is divided into three branches: Attack, Defense and Support. Any hero can learn skills in all three branches, but each of them has their own preferences in training. So attacking heroes will learn the strongest skills of the attack branch, and defense heroes will learn the strongest skills of the defense branch. 
But the personal preferences of the heroes also play a role. Two attacking heroes can have different number of levels in the same skills, and all because one hero prefers the speed of projectiles, and the other strength of blows.  
To train heroes in the Academy, you will need Runes and gold coins. Each branch of development needs its own runes. The level of the Academy determines how many skills you can learn each individual hero, as well as the maximum rarity of these skills. 
Where can you find runes? It's very simple:

 they will now be sold like any other resource in the marketplace
 Look for them at points of interest in matches
 defeat bosses in matches and get them as a reward.
 rune sets in a jar - fast and convenient!


Weapons Portal Improvements
We really want every prism spent by the Braves to bring joy. Therefore, we are happy to announce that from now on, you will not encounter items from the Popadanz set in all weapon portals. Also, the minimum rarity of items in weapon portals has been changed to Rare. Now no items of ordinary and unusual rarity! But that's not all, when you summon x10 you will be guaranteed to get an epic item!

Reinforcement of old heroes
We continue a good tradition of revising the skills of old heroes to make the game with them more enjoyable for all Braves. This time, three heroes have new powers, and the most interesting thing is that all three of them are elves. Coincidence? Who knows? Meet the renewed Midnight Witch, Slippery Ice, and Dancing Flame.
Dancing Flame. Epic rarity:

 Draconid Form:
 Increased chance to turn into a draconid when dealing damage to an enemy.
 Fire Sphere. In addition to the familiar puddles of magma, Dancing Flame can now unleash a Fire Sphere that deals massive fire damage to anyone in its path and then explodes. The direction of the sphere is customizable, and will point wherever the mouse cursor (or right stick, in the case of the joystick) is pointing during activation.
 +75% to the size of Plamedrag and its evolution 

Slippery Ice. Epic Rarity:

 Draconid Form:
 Increased chance to turn into a draconid when taking damage.
 Ice Sphere. In addition to the familiar puddles of ice, Slippery Ice can now unleash an Ice Sphere that deals massive water damage to anyone in its path and then explodes. The direction of the sphere is customizable, and will point wherever the mouse cursor (or right stick, in the case of the joystick) is pointing during activation.
 +75% to the size and evolution of the Chladodryg. 

Midnight Witch. Epic Rarity:

 +2 Cursed Sickles projectiles (was +1)

notes.title: Sands Of Time update
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We are back to tell you all about the recent additions to the game! What awaits you in the current update?

New Portals Opening

Summer is coming to an end, but the ether currents are still filled with red-hot wind and burning sand... Behold the Portals of the Scorching Sun and Desert Treasures!

Three new, unique heroes await you in the Portal of the Scorching Sun. It is time you finally meet them:

Bastet 

Legendary Heroine. Filled with ancient wisdom and piety, Bastet is ready to stand up for the innocent souls of Singor and locate the source of evil that has poisoned these lands. What does this cute-looking feline hold in her arsenal?

Legendary rarity

 The Wisdom of the Desert. Bastet possesses vast knowledge of long-forgotten ancient peoples, allowing her to learn an extra passive skill.
 Perfect Calculations. Bastet knows how to make the most of every shot. When the number of projectiles launched with any skill reaches 3, all subsequent projectiles will deal 30% more damage upon every activation. For example, if Bastet launches 5 fireballs, the first 2 will deal normal damage with each activation, while fireballs 3, 4, and 5 will deal additional damage.
 +35% damage dealt with the Thread of Life skill and its evolution
 -7% damage dealt with other skills
 -15% skill cooldown
 +1 Samsara Carpet skill evolution level 

 Mythical rarity

 The Fury of the Desert. The desert can be a treacherous place, but Bastet is not: she is used to shining her light upon the poor and taking up arms to protect the defenseless… And yet, woe be to those who provoke her wrath. Bastet's Mythical Rarity variation has a chance to learn an extra active skill.
 +2 Thread of Life skill levels at the start of the match
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/f6f3ee891e60f00210fa3dff5a6b8faf80de9e1b.png

Sobek

Legendary Hero. You always know when Sobek is nearby due to his dark aura of pain and misery. After fighting and devouring darkness for centuries, Sobek's heart had eventually hardened, and the sinister arts he swore to ward off began to take hold of him. What can this Legendary Hero do?

 Legendary rarity

 Sobek's Rage. Upon receiving damage for the first time in a fight, Sobek falls into a rage, barely able to contain the malevolent power within. A destructive aura spreads, causing damage to anyone who would dare approach him.
 Thorns of Darkness. After receiving damage, Sobek has a chance to summon Thorns of Darkness in a large radius around him. These will deal damage to the hero's enemies, while also slowing down their movement speed and attack rate. This skill can activate once every 15 seconds.
 +35% damage dealt with the Thread of Fate skill and its evolution
 -7% damage to other skills
 -50% cooldown time for the Thread of Fate skill, but note that cooldown time will increase by 5% for every 2 levels, up to level 10, at which point the cooldown bonus will be reduced to just -25%.
 50% larger Thread of Fate skill's area of effect

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/34c598145eb79a9858ba9991c0fbad3c74323075.png

Kashta 

Epic Hero. Do you know the saying "one-man army"? Whoever coined it has probably met Kashta. Legends have it that this warrior crossed the desert and seized the royal throne all by himself. Sounds promising, does it not? Let us see what this hero can do!

 +1 Samsara Carpet skill evolution level on Mythical Rarity
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/307832a36f0a5a115123a99b1070671d757bc6f1.png

New Skills

The folk wisdom holds that a person's life is a canvas, with their every action woven onto it, creating an intricate pattern where it intersects the lifelines of others. It is also rumored that the sages of an ancient kingdom have learned to control these threads, and that their domain now lies in ruin as the result—swept away by the Sand Dunes, with evil abominations stalking through what were once prosperous cities... But who knows how much truth there is to these old tales? You should take them with a grain of salt. What we do know for sure is that Academy scientists have recently discovered two hitherto unseen skills and their evolutions. Judging by the ancient scrolls, we are dealing with:

The Thread of Life
Type: Offensive Skill. Element: Holy. When activated, horizontal stands of pure light stretch across the entire battlefield. Their divine power is so strong that any opponent that touches them will receive a lot of damage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/bdf5f74874ca4d21f55d7d91de8de94f1e716322.png

Type: Offensive Skill. Element: Spiritual. When activated, vertical stands of accursed darkness stretch across the entire battlefield. The pain of a thousand tormented souls within causes spiritual damage to any enemy unlucky enough to stand in their way.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/4cf87043e2fcfc14883bd3e2620d4e42709a6604.png

Samsara Carpet
Type: Evolution. Element: Holy/Spiritual. Recipe: Thread of Life (Lv. 8) + Thread of Fate (Lv. 8). This evolution may look the same as any other, but the Samsara Carpet does not require any passive skills—only the two active ones. When activated, the entire battlefield will be lined with horizontal and vertical strands, covering it like a carpet and causing damage to anyone who comes into contact with them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/c5965352285f54a4249c6873db57f91ca5bf573f.png

New Weapon

New skills work best with new weapons, right? And new weapons have already arrived in abundance to all the evil bosses of Singoru and, of course, to the Portal of the Eternal Soul, the Portal of the Scorching Sun, and the Portal of the Desert Treasures. Here, take a look:

The Key of Life. Grants the Thread of Life skill when equipped.

 +25% damage dealt with the Thread of Life on Unusual Rarity
 +4% damage dealt with all skills on rare rarity
 +1 Thread of Life skill level at the start of the match on Epic Rarity
 +6% damage dealt with all skills on Legendary Rarity
 +1 Samsara Carpet skill evolution level on Mythical Rarity
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/eefbe026b0a4235ca26c544d02263961f204bb1e.png
The Key of Death. Grants the Thread of Fate skill when equipped.

 +25% damage dealt with the Thread of Fate on Unusual Rarity
 +4% damage dealt with all skills on Rare Rarity
 +1 Thread of Fate skill level at the start of the match on Epic Rarity
 +6% damage dealt with all skills on Legendary Rarity
 +1 Samsara Carpet skill evolution level on Mythical Rarity
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/923140f4f8ba4cbdc8b13b034cc54436da5496d8.png

New achievements
New heroes come with new achievements! Unlock them all and become the true savior of Singoru!

Also hurry up to enter the mystic code with nice gifts, in honor of the update: SANDSOFTIME.
Hurry up, because the promo code is active until 01.09.24

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ca6ed5eecf6cb219a48414d868e1190854b9e35e.png
That is it for now, Brave Ones! A big update is coming soon, with new events, hero upgrades, and much more! Stay tuned and do not forget to share your thoughts and suggestions—as always, we look forward to reading your feedback!

Natural beauty mixed with dangers waiting at every turn will not leave indifferent even the most sophisticated heroes. 
You will find a lot of new monsters, bosses and, of course, generous rewards for defeating them! 
And for those brave men who have reached the pinnacle of skill in normal mode, they are already waiting in Hardcore Ridge. 

 New Achievements:

Opening a new location can mean not only new adventures, but also new challenges and achievements! Test your luck and skills, try to collect them all!

 New quests:

New tasks are already ready for the Town Hall task board, both for normal and Hardcore modes. Those brave men who have already completed all the tasks before them will be able to fill their wallets with pleasant and useful rewards! 

Scrolling through task chapters in the Town Hall:

Would you like to know what challenges await you in the future? Now this is as easy as scrolling through several chapters of tasks in advance. The game has a new feature that allows you to view not yet available chapters in the Town Hall and complete tasks in advance.

Frame Rate limit:

You asked — we did it! In the game settings, you can now choose to limit the number of frames per second: 30, 60, 100, or no limits. Enjoy the adventure according to your own rules.

In addition, we have done everything possible to make it as comfortable as possible for you to play. Now you can collect rewards with just one click. You no longer need to collect each reward individually — this saves you time and simplifies the game process.

Updated Loading Screens:

The best artists of Singoru (who had not yet had time to eat the terrible monsters) tirelessly painted portraits of heroes who are led into battle by Brave Men. Meet the updated loading screens and the new Braves logo. We hope that you will like them. 
Hints have also been added during loading. So you can not only enjoy new works of art, but also learn something new!

New building appearance:

Is it a shame when you build and build, but the appearance of your buildings does not change? Stop putting up with it! We've added new building looks for level 21-25. All this is designed to make your eyes enjoy something truly new!

Disabling markers in a match:

In the heat of battle, it can sometimes be difficult to focus because of the many markers and pointers. We understand that! Now, by clicking just one button, you can hide (and then show again) all placemarks related to points of interest and auxiliary items.

Symbol Abbreviation:

We've all had it happen that when we looked at the amount of resources needed to reach a new Town Hall level, we couldn't tell if it was hundreds of thousands or millions. Even too lazy to count how many zeros and ones there are.
Now large numbers will be presented in a more convenient way. Instead of a lot of zeros and ones, we will see only the first few digits of the number with a postscript. For example, 100M or 10K. However, if you hover over the number you are interested in, you can still see the exact number of resources.

Also we give you a mystic code in honor of the update:  ridgewinds

Well, that's all the news for today. Wait for more updates, read our diaries and just enjoy life in Singoru. After all, you are Brave and you can do anything!

Thanks to your suggestions, brave men, we are introducing a new system for gaining experience. Now the heroes will be able to gain levels not only by reading volumes of heroic manga in the cozy walls of the tavern, but also by performing various feats. Send them into battle and watch their experience grow.
